svg.title: ukiyo e woodblock fete poster
svg.text: Live folk music from The Muddy Boots
Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick
In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund

g.data-flaw: The title is brush lettering no face matches, and blanking it leaves pale smears on the graded sky.
g.data-outlook: A dead end for the title: hand-brushed, over a gradient that cannot be repainted exactly.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. The title is brush lettering no face matches, and blanking it leaves pale smears on the graded sky. A dead end for the title: hand-brushed, over a gradient that cannot be repainted exactly.
